title: When the Promise Wakes
author: Isandro Galloway
blurb: Juniper Sterling, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
